I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. `wj run --verify main.wj` exits 0: the interpreter and the compiled build give identical output.

I ran it on both examples plus a blank line and `2023-02-29 2023-03-01`. The output matched the expected `60 Monday`, `2 Monday`, `0 Sunday` and `invalid`. The Feb 29 line in a non-leap year printed `invalid`, and the blank line was skipped. I didn't test other edge
